scripts.lint: bun run --cwd backend lint && bun run --cwd frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd schemas typecheck
scripts.typecheck:all: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:frontend
scripts.code: bunx biome check backend schemas types package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json eslint.config.base.mjs frontend/eslint.config.mjs
scripts.code:fix: bunx biome check --write backend schemas types package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json eslint.config.base.mjs frontend/eslint.config.mjs
